known_discrepancies: Current reference code uses even realFFT and mean shell radius;2018 published supplementary code uses odd fullFFT and half-bin shell coordinates. This task reproduces selected current reference variant with one qualified average correction.
Current original final_chi2/Rg refer to pre-final-projection intensity, not returned rho; all evaluation metrics here are independently recomputed from final signed rho.
Final Fourier projection violates real-space positivity/support softly; tails are retained and quantified.
